heroBody: Our mission is to democratize technology and ensure prosperety for all humanity. We are committed to free, democratized, humane AI aligned with the values of humanity, not the interests of elites. Heraldic is a pioneer company in AI governance solutions, with a commitment to open-source software, Web3.0, blockchain, privacy-respecting anti-tracking apps, and distributed applications. Everything we build, we build in service of humanity.

visionTitle: A personal desktop, without a physical box.
visionBody: Our cloud computing services pair virtualized resources with the devices people already use.
capabilityBody: Heraldic’s cloud computing services use virtual hardware to extend what a device can do.
capabilityOneBody: Create additional capacity without installing physical components.
capabilityTwoBody: Support work on an older PC or lightweight device through a hosted desktop.
capabilityThreeBody: Use an operating environment and applications from wherever an internet connection is available.
systemsBody: Our cloud offerings connect powerful computing, everyday work, and accessible learning without storefronts, signup flows, or affiliate links.
eleetBody: A powerful personal cloud desktop for graphics-intensive work, helping a local device stay cool and light.
powerBody: A flexible cloud PC concept for office work and entertainment, intended to be reachable across desktop and mobile devices.
newbieBody: A free, lightweight Linux environment centered on web use, creativity, study, and broader access to computing.
privacyTitle: Trust should be part of the architecture.
privacyBodyOne: We believe humane technology should respect the people it serves. We do not believe your data is gold, and we will never collect or sell your data. Transparency is key to trust.
privacyBodyTwo: Our apps are privacy-respecting and anti-tracking by design, with no trackers, ads, affiliate storefronts, or third-party embeds on this site. Messages you submit to Artem AI are sent to OpenAI to generate a reply.
missionBody: Our services and goals include liberating technology through cloud computing, business automation, gaming cloud desktops, AI social media, and our goal to build AGI. Heraldic is also a pioneer company in AI governance solutions. We are committed to free, democratized, humane AI aligned with the values of humanity, alongside open-source software, Web3.0, blockchain, privacy-respecting anti-tracking apps, and distributed applications. Everything we build is intended to serve humanity.
